items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 2:1
items.html: The lights that ascended are the light of the records. Likewise, wherever you find ascent or correction with respect to lights, know that they are lights of records, for ascent and correction do not apply to the upper light, but only departure to its root alone. (p. 600, Item 3)
